runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 18:54 public-web sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. LinkedIn surfaced CloudTalk Customer Support Representative (100% remote/Europe) but fluent English is mandatory, and TalentPop requires German plus English. Direct Slovak Telekom discovery surfaced Junior DevOps in Bratislava but the Linux/cloud/CI-CD scope is above the target profile. Upwork produced several WordPress/VA candidates, but they were rejected for hard development, strong written English/automation ownership, unsustainable workload or implausibly low fixed-price economics. Reddit yielded no suitable employer-demand hit. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate rejection evidence fingerprint
developmentChanges.reason: Persist a compact hash of the decisive rejection evidence (language, location, skill or economics) together with the canonical URL. On later runs, unchanged rejected listings can be skipped cheaply while any changed requirement forces a fresh review. This reduces repeated work without hiding materially updated vacancies.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance budget-to-workload sanity gate
developmentChanges.reason: Before ranking freelance work, compare stated fixed budget against required deliverables, hours, availability and ownership burden. Flag impossible combinations such as 120 WordPress articles for 30 USD or 12-hour six-day schedules for 600 USD, preventing attractive keywords from masking economically unusable work.
